name: Kitstarter
author: Kitstarter

sections.description:
Kitstarter is a powerful Elementor add-on that gives you access to 800+ professionally designed components.
Save thousands of hours with our extensive component library.

Features

  • 800+ pre-built components
  • Seamless Elementor integration
  • Regular updates with new components
  • Responsive designs
  • Easy drag-and-drop functionality

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.2 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Elementor (free version) installed and activated

External services

This plugin connects to our external API server (elementor.kitstarter.io) to fetch the component library and template data.

It sends the template ID and entity type when you request a component to be inserted into your Elementor page. No personal user data is sent.
This service is provided by Kitstarter.
Service URL: https://elementor.kitstarter.io
Privacy Policy: https://kitstarter.io/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://kitstarter.io/terms-conditions
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/kitstarter, or install directly through WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Open Elementor editor and look for the Kitstarter button.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, Kitstarter requires Elementor (free version) to be installed and activated.

Is there a pro version?

Visit kitstarter.io for premium features and extended component libraries.

How do I get support?

For support, please visit our website at kitstarter.io.
